beats.text: For the record: Crawler Carl's Scavenger's Daughter patch blinks, not knowing what it sees, and Lucia Mar crosses from her moped to him in a blink and whispers in his ear. Chalchiuhtlicue is here. She is new to this place, and she does not need Cici or Gus the way the Residual and the Primal did. She tells the children she is kind and means to protect them, and that the kindest thing may be to let them die. More are coming. The veins are open. All seek the prize on the twelfth floor. Then the presence is gone, and the patch shudders in fear.

beats.headline: The shining lady talks to Yaz
beats.text: When the presence withdraws, a frightened child surfaces in Lucia's body instead: Azra, whose sister Yaz is here too, crying. The shining lady, Azra says, is talking to Yaz, telling her Crawler Carl won his races with a spell their father gave him. Their father owns a bowling alley. The angel lady, Azra says, thinks it might be better if they all die, and keeps talking about people coming to take their bodies. It is so cold. Florin asks who is coming. Azra notices him, shrieks, and runs.

beats.headline: Carl asks him, of everyone
beats.text: The Royal Court of Princess Donut takes the heat, with the Lady Dominators and Crawler Osvaldo's crew close behind it, and the first thing Crawler Carl does with the win is send a message to Jasha: there is somebody still out on the track who can be pulled off it. Jasha asks whether he truly means to save that one, the worst of them. Tow him in if he will let you, Crawler Carl says, and be wary. I file the request itself, because who a crawler asks is a fact about the crawler.

beats.headline: Second, and a grudge
beats.text: Heat Four. Team Sparkles screams at them from the starting line, and Crawler Carl judges they very likely hold a grudge over the blast at the last finish, which puts Corky at risk. The GTO takes the same trail as the court, and Genesis, in the passenger seat, gives the truck a four-armed obscene gesture on the way past. In Satan's Water Park they trade blows with the unicorn at the loop. The Dominators finish second.

beats.headline: Chalchiuhtlicue is here
beats.text: I look at the man and the cat. Then I am close to him, closer than he likes. Chalchiuhtlicue is here. She is new. She says she is kind and she will protect us. She says the kindest thing may be letting us die. We are vessels in the river, and so is he. The veins are open. Everything trapped is coming, for the prize on the twelfth floor. It is not a game like they told me. It is not a game like they told him.

beats.headline: Azra asks for her father
beats.text: Lucia steps back, shrinks, and somebody else is looking out of her face. A girl, Azra, with her sister Yaz beside her, crying: the shining lady says Carl knows her father, that he gave Carl a spell. He owns a bowling alley. Carl tells her he is safe and loves her. She says the angel lady keeps talking about people coming to take their bodies, and that it is cold. When Florin asks who, she runs.

beats.headline: First in heat four
beats.text: Heat Four. First place, the Royal Court of Princess Donut, driven for the last stretch by a dead camel, after a run of clockwork toads. Second, the Lady Dominators and the Gimp. Third, Team Flamengo. Fourth, Team Free Love. Fifth, team Sparkles. One Fine Pig is eliminated. The next track is a screw factory, steel mill and doll workshop, and containment theft is now on.

beats.headline: Swatted off the loop
beats.text: In Satan's Water Park Team Sparkles and Florin's team harass each other all the way down, Florin trying to stop his driver, Lucia Mar's psycho personality, from killing them. Both vehicles are nearly round the loop-de-loop when Satan headbutts it over and swats them through the air. The vine, on fire and covered in goo from a Denial of Service missile, splats to the ground. Lucienne, charmed by Crawler Donut's vermin spell, comes apart passing through the court's windshield at the finish. Team Sparkles finishes fifth.

beats.headline: Five teams of twenty-four
beats.text: If this is my last message, know that I tried to stop them fighting Li Na. I tried. Then, after: I'm alive. We won. Zhang was leading their octopus and let me pass. They tried to stop her, and it went the way it went in Beijing. She cast a dread and they killed each other. Of twenty-four teams that started, five are left. From our heat, only my team and theirs. Zhang needs help. He was sobbing. I don't know what to do.

beats.headline: Samantha knows her
beats.text: Samantha, sniffing Crawler Carl, wants to know why he smells like Chachi. Chalchiuhtlicue, she clarifies: green skirt, talks funny, cries a lot. Her assessment: Chachi is pretty, not emotionally stable, and always talking about saving the lives of children before killing them all. Once, at a party, the meatballs had cilantro in them, so Chachi had her worshippers kill a whole village day care in the hope the next tray tasted better. It worked, Samantha adds. Carl realises this is the goddess Lucia named.

beats.headline: Rescued by people he was rude to
beats.text: Team Sparkles is still in this race, which by every reasonable projection it should not be. Jasha and Radoslav of team Free Love found Dwight spinning in circles just outside the exit and dragged him in. I record outcomes rather than motives, so I will confine myself to the facts: the two who did it are the two whose van he once drove straight over.

beats.headline: She picks the upgrades for them
beats.text: The upgrade board goes up again and Hedy walks the party through it again, subdued this time, because she can read the room. She has watched what this course does to a chassis. They have only felt it. Her advice is taken, which on the whole is more than the advice of anyone else in that garage that day managed.

beats.headline: They go back for Dwight
beats.text: Jasha and Radoslav went back onto a live course and pulled Dwight out of it, which is the only reason Team Sparkles is still racing. Crawler Carl suggested it, and Jasha asked whether he meant that one, the worst of them. Nobody would have said a word if they had driven past, and a great many spectators would have preferred it. Team Free Love did it anyway, promptly, for a team that would not have done it for them. I file this under: awake.

beats.headline: The tourist is his brother
beats.text: Linus is dead. Syndicate security killed him in his own trash-filled berth in orbit over Teelan-3, surrounded by posters of the fairy crawler he followed. His brother Minus, a soother, is given five hundred hours of footage, his brother's posts and a ship bought with his brother's money, and sent down as Linus before the tenth floor opens: half-corporeal, a non-combatant, attached to the fairy crawler. He has a primary and a secondary target. He is told to act the pervert for a while.

beats.headline: A gecko in the garage
beats.text: Okay so, we won a key, and I used it, and now there's a gecko in my garage. Like a whole second ride. I did what Carl said and checked for the hidden room in the house, and there was an engineer in there, which is, no joke, a great find. There were also mobs in the house. Nobody mentioned the mobs. Be careful if you're doing it, man. Anyway. Pretty sweet.

beats.headline: Chachi
beats.text: Why does Carl smell like Chachi? Chalchiuhtlicue. Green skirt, talks funny, cries a lot. Don't hide her from me, I'm not jealous. Okay, I don't usually give advice after a breakup, but: she's pretty, and she is CUCKOO. Always talking about saving children, and then something inconvenient happens and it's sacrifice a seven-year-old. She had a whole village day care killed at a Yarilo party over cilantro in the meatballs. It worked, though. And now Carl is triple-dipping with her and Eris and a wife? No mustache, even.

beats.headline: Towed in by the van it flattened
beats.text: Team Sparkles is still in the race only because team Free Love dragged it in. Jasha asked whether Crawler Carl really thought they should save him, the worst of them; Carl told the bugbears to tow Dwight in if he would let them, and to be wary. They found the unicorn spinning in a circle just outside the exit and dragged him in. The court, meanwhile, picks its next upgrades and takes the regular version of the booster rockets Team Sparkles has, which with its new bubble will let the truck cover large jumps.

beats.headline: A suicide mission, from security
beats.text: Captain Fresh of Syndicate security says it plainly to the soldier going in under a dead fan's name: it is a suicide mission. The Syndicate is trying to nuke the whole system off the map before it spreads further, and losing; the AI stops everything and answers in kind. A surgical crawler kill, they believe, will destabilise the group, start the Ascendency game early and let their other assets move. It is us or them, he says. The viewers who will not stop watching are to blame too.

beats.headline: Asking around about Chachi
beats.text: I send the same question to Rosetta, Mordecai, Tipid and Prepotente at once: who is this Chalchiuhtlicue, and why did my Scavenger's Daughter patch try to go off while I was talking to Lucia? Rosetta says she's a minor goddess of childbirth, water and fire, never sponsored, weak in the Ascendency game. Mordecai says what he always says, which is that nobody knows, this is all new. Donut says we're calling her Chachi. My question stands. If she can get from wherever those kids are to here, can we go the other way?

beats.headline: Rarely sponsored, often weak
beats.text: Crawler Carl asks around. Rosetta: Chachi, as Samantha calls her, is not well known and has never been sponsored that she remembers. Like Eileithyia, she is a goddess of childbirth and women, but also of water and fire, and of harvests. Catch-all deities look good on the manifest and do poorly in the Ascendency game, their powers being comparatively weak. Crawler Donut declares that she is to be called Chachi. Prepotente supplies the Earth analog, an Aztec goddess of the same name, benevolent, whose crying for many days began a flood myth.

beats.headline: Removed from the garage of One Fine Pig
beats.text: The garage of One Fine Pig, entered without invitation, and Penelope leaves it in the company of Carl and Donut. Ownership of a pig is not a category I keep records in, so I will put it plainly. The sow has changed hands. The thunder god's protection has not changed at all. Every crawler now sharing a vehicle with her is standing inside the blast radius of somebody else's affection, and I have said as much to anyone who would listen.

beats.headline: He has read up on Chachi
beats.text: The analog in your culture, since you ask, is the Aztec goddess of the same name. Benevolent, supposedly, in a civilisation that practised human sacrifice, and the origin of a flood myth because she cried for many days. It is somewhat interesting how closely these gods track your pantheons. I, too, intend to enter this guild. I will be performing "In the Air Tonight" by Phil Collins. The cat's number is a surprise and a duet, and Carl requires potions and scrolls to survive it. That sounds like a hoot.

beats.headline: We are calling her Chachi
beats.text: WE'RE JUST GOING TO CALL HER CHACHI. I only have so much room on my cut-and-paste, and I am not filling it with a name that long. Anyway, it is concert day. Prepotente is coming, and he is singing as well, which is lovely for him. Mine is a surprise. It will be a duet with Carl, and he has to take a great many potions and scrolls first so that he does not mess it up. Then we go and collect the pig from the empty house.

beats.headline: Trust me on this one
beats.text: Donut wants the whole plan and I can't give it to her yet. The prize is two people of our choosing brought to the eleventh floor, and she's scared I mean to hurt somebody she likes. So I tell her what I can: I'm scared too, and the pig, this quest and the war mage plan will all help us survive. I'll explain once it's too late for them to take the prize away. Then Zhang says what he means to do, and I see it. Li Na can't worship a god. She's a weapon. She just needs pointing. I message Bodi.

beats.headline: A fleshmancer among the crumbs
beats.text: For the record: Grigori the Placid. Human, level ninety-three Fleshmancer, a hired mercenary of Team Meadow Lark, worshipper of Gula. Elle and Imani hired him and bring him to the Lollipop, where he sits bolt upright between Louis and Linus with a cappuccino, flicking cookie crumbs off his blue robes. Crawler Carl wants him to talk to both halves of Corcunda. Elle reports that he has a stick up his backside. She also reports that he knows what he is doing, and he and Imani have been trading healing tips.

beats.headline: She is not a weapon
beats.text: Carl says we need people like Li Na, because she is so strong. She is not a weapon, Carl. She is a person. I like her, of course I do, but we cannot let her keep hurting people, and we certainly cannot let Zhang kill himself to stop her. That is not right, and I told Zhang no, twice. We will find something to fix this. Somebody has to talk some sense into her. It is the only way.

beats.headline: Not bad, just lost
beats.text: Zhang says it's his fault. It isn't. It isn't all Na's, either. They attacked her. Rezan was an ass, and the decapitator had it coming. She didn't take player-killer skulls, because it was her dreads that did it, and they all killed each other. Zhang wants to kill their mount mid-race so the system takes them both. Carl says that won't work any more: Na just loses containment and reaches the line without one. She isn't killing for fun. She's lost her humanity. Those are different problems.

beats.headline: He offers to go with her
beats.text: Li Na has gone somewhere none of us can reach, and everyone who rode with us in the last heat is dead. So I say it out loud in the Lollipop with everyone listening: next race, I kill our own mount. That takes her out of it. It takes me out of it too, and I have thought about that part, and it is still the cleanest thing I can see. Carl says it will not work any more: we only lose our containment, and she can reach the finish without a mount where I cannot. He says there has to be another way.

beats.headline: It's a go
beats.text: Splash Zone says the casino plan is a bust, so it's the cleaner bots. Li Na's poison won't clear, and it'll get worse, because health tops up on every new floor. If Herot's real and the war mages weren't lying about the Cabaret, getting her through stops that, keeps Zhang alive, stops her killing crawlers, and tests the route before we try it with a crowd. It only works if she agrees. She's too smart to trick, and I wouldn't want to. Everyone at the table is looking at me. "It's a go." Tran bows.

beats.headline: Sold out due to overwhelming demand
beats.text: Since the previous floor, crawlers have been complaining that the Cleaner Bot upgrade is missing from the personal space shop, due to "overwhelming demand." Everyone blamed warlords stockpiling for Faction Wars, which was partly true. The white one Carl looted from Architect Houston's surgical theatre was an old model and, as it happens, the last one the store had. The rest of the demand has a single name: Herot, with a standing order to buy every cleaner bot that shows up. Which makes a household appliance the most interesting item in the shop.

beats.headline: An audience granted
beats.text: Splash Zone, in chat, while Crawler Carl is busy separating a goat from a unicorn: he has asked for an audience with Hamed, the new leader guy, to see whether he can help find Splash Zone's wife. The guards said Hamed would see him. So he, Gluteus and Doctor Bones are going to talk to him. He is sending Bucket Boy over to Carl in the meantime.

beats.headline: He has a standing order for cleaner bots
beats.text: The shop-interface route is the one nobody can test, and the reason is a standing purchase order. Two answers are on file. Menerva is on the seventeenth floor. Herot is inside the cabaret itself, and he has a standing purchase order in with the shop for every cleaner bot it will sell him, which he has evidently been putting to some use of his own. Somebody shut in a box for cycles has been quietly buying the delivery vehicles. I will leave that where it sits.

beats.headline: She is on the seventeenth floor
beats.text: The plan Mordecai and Rosetta are working on runs through a shop interface and a standing order for cleaner bots, and it puts the two builders in different places. Herot is in the cabaret. Menerva is on the seventeenth floor, in charge of the NPCs building and occupying the maze there. Nobody in that room has been within seven floors of the seventeenth, and this crawl is presently on the tenth. I hold a very great many records. I am not going to tell you which of them account for that.

beats.headline: The test worked, mostly
beats.text: Believe it or not, the test worked. Samantha can't die and she's not what you'd call a reliable subject, so we ran it again on some sluggalos. It works. There are a few wrinkles, and I'm working on them right now. But listen to me, kid. This is so far off the codex we don't even know the system will let Li Na do it. And if it does, she could still die when your floor collapses. He says he knows. He always says he knows.

beats.headline: A standing order for cleaner bots
beats.text: Mordecai reports that the test worked, on Samantha and then on some sluggalos. The explanation for the missing cleaner bots is Herot, inside the Cabaret with limited powers and a shop interface and a standing order to buy every one that appears. Menerva runs the NPCs building the Backstage Death Maze on the seventeenth floor. The Cabaret itself is overrun, by ogres from a binned plotline, a shadow mimic infestation and more, and the war mages want help clearing it. The casino plan looks like a bust. Li Na, dying of poison, is to go first, if she can be talked into it.

beats.headline: Potions, a scroll, and A-ha
beats.text: I've never sung in my life, except hammered in a bar with a bunch of coasties, years ago. So Mordecai compounds potions to get round the cooldowns, and I'm Honeyed, Yo-Yo Ma'd and Dio'd. There's a scroll called Gelded Choirboy for the notes my voice can't reach. Mordecai insists the name isn't literal. I read it at the last second and sound like I've sucked on a helium balloon. The song is "Take on Me." I take the lead, so Donut's few lines have the better odds. Then the unicorn stabs the DJ.

beats.headline: The horn and the disc jockey
beats.text: The Lollipop, packed to the walls, Crawler Carl full of bard potions and climbing onto a stage to sing his way into a guild. Dwight is drunk at the front of the room. As the pair of them get up there he drives his horn through the disc jockey's face. The disc jockey had been shouting at him. Beyond that there was no faction in it, nothing at stake and nothing to gain. He simply did it, in a room already full of armed strangers looking for a reason.

beats.headline: Transferred, and brushing a cat
beats.text: Mercenary ownership of Grigori has been transferred to Crawler Carl's guild. His first duty under new management is brushing Crawler Donut, which she has arranged personally, and he appears to be enjoying himself. Linus, who has been stroking Donut's tail and whispering to her, is taken away by Elle. Grigori's first recorded word comes a moment after, when Donut asks whether she should perform with or without sunglasses. With, he says. She agrees.

beats.headline: Looking forward to this
beats.text: Donut has zapped Mongo into the bar so he won't miss Uncle Carl's stage debut, and the patrons are jumping back from his wings. Carl won't tell us why this quest matters so much. I don't need to know. I tell him the truth, and I smile when I do it: I've been looking forward to this moment for a long time. He says he hopes I like Norwegian music. Elle is going to be furious she missed it. I wave Chris, Florin, Bautista, Britney and Jurgen to the back, and suddenly the place is packed.

beats.headline: Singing through a bar fight
beats.text: The DJ's dead, so this is our only shot, and the music keeps going. I sing. Bottles break on me. I kick a gremlin and a Draconian off the stage before they reach Donut, catch her microphone stand between my big and index toe, and bounce off the stage when the curtains go up. I hit the high note and the gauge by my head throws sparks. Permanent access to the Stage Performance Guild, and an achievement, Sing for your supper. The sign over Donut says FAILED. I guess I gotta do this myself.

beats.headline: Nickels, not gold
beats.text: A brawl in the Lollipop, and a crawler singing through it, and so I take up Mr. Jefferson and sweep the stage clear before him, howling as I go. A mantis creature tears the good sock open as I strike her, and out come the coins, and half the room falls upon them. They are nickels. Every one of them is a nickel, though I have been feeding him honest gold pieces. I do not understand it.

beats.headline: One drunk unicorn, one wrecked duet
beats.text: He follows it by hurling the dead disc jockey at Crawler Carl and Crawler Donut, misses, and hits a demon of team Yokai, which draws in the Minister of Blood-Letting and his skeletons and then most of the floor. Carl's allies spend the entire song trying to keep the teams in that room from murdering each other. On the last line of the thing Crawler Donut is knocked flat by a paralysed kappa and loses the entry she had just sung for. Crawler Carl gets in alone. One drunk unicorn, one wrecked duet, one guild place where there should have been two.

beats.headline: Into the fight
beats.text: MOTHER singing. Loud. FIGHT. Tail. People fall over. Fairy throws fire at Imani. Fairy is FOOD. MOTHER has beer on her. Lick MOTHER. MOTHER is cross.

beats.headline: Robbed of a perfect score
beats.text: My part was perfect, Auto-Tuned and in key, and in the middle of a chorus I shot the axe out of a Draconian's hand before he could put it in Dong's head. Then, on my very last line, a paralysed kappa fell backward right into me, and now there is a sign over my head that says FAILED. I was robbed of a perfect score. Carl has to go through the glowing door by himself. We are never going to mention this again. I do love that song, though.

beats.headline: A running list of gods
beats.text: Jurgen asks a better question than I'd managed: can people who worship gods not go to the Cabaret, or do the war mages just not want them there? Akuma lied to us about needing two teams dead, so he could be lying about this too. I've been keeping a running list of every god I hear of, sorted by affiliation and skill. Donar goes on it: thunder and lightning, like Thor but manlier, not sponsored this season, and he's given Jurgen lightning spells. My heart skips a beat. Then I'm through the door, and the guildmaster is stuck in his own zipper.

beats.headline: There are two of him
beats.text: The shape of the problem, finally stated out loud. Corcunda is not one person in one place. A spell called Split Personality went off a long time ago and split him in two, and both halves lived through it: Corky, riding in the back of the Lady Dominators' car, and Porky, hopping on a single foot behind the doors of the stage performance guild, which Crawler Carl has just sung his way into. Porky agrees to the reunion. Porky also has terms, and the terms are that somebody afterwards answers for how this happened, and that somebody is Dong.

beats.headline: Somebody has to answer for the children
beats.text: The bar fight is over and the nickels are still being picked up off the floor, and I cannot wait for Carl to finish his errand. There is a goddess threatening to kill all the children. He tells me the only thing to do from this side is talk Lucia into a deal. Then send me out, I tell him, the way the others will go. He says I cannot, because of the god I worship. So I tell him the rest. I used to be able to talk to Heidi, and I have not heard her in a while. She is pregnant. I have to get to her.

beats.headline: A crawler sings his way through the door
beats.text: A crawler sings his way through my door, which nobody has managed in a while, and then asks me to be put back together with Corky. Fine. I want it too. It would be nice not to have to lean against everything again. But I set a condition and I set it plainly: when it is done, somebody helps me deal with the one who is actually responsible for all of this. And for the crawler's information, the females of my kind do not answer to Grull. They worship Enyo, an unhinged goddess of war. I answered to Grull once. The devotion went when I split, and I do not miss it.

beats.headline: O-o-o-offered
beats.text: Carl enters the Stage Performance Guild, and the welcome notification invites the performer to see the guildmaster for the services o-o-o-offered. He notes that even the routine dungeon notices are glitching out more often now. It is a small stutter at the door of a dusty theatre with one spotlight in it, heard by one crawler on his own.

beats.headline: A bad night outside the Lady Dominators' garage
beats.text: Bad night. Splash Zone and Gluteus Maxx and Dr. Bones went to talk to Hamed and now nobody can raise them, because they are not on this floor any more. Dong is properly ill, with a debuff over him I have never seen before. I grabbed the sock to ask it what was wrong and it went for me, and then it was just gone, teleported out by the safe room, and I do not know what happened. Meanwhile the others go to the Lady Dominators' garage to get Corcunda out, and the car is already rolling out for the line before anyone gets in. I am not a soldier. I keep finding myself in the room where the soldiering happens.

beats.headline: He could have been kinder
beats.text: Dong's cursed. Mordecai says the sock has gone, and without it and every nickel the NPCs grabbed, a temple won't help. I gave him that sock. I got it from Quan Ch. The Dominators heard us outside their garage and drove for the starting line with Corky in the back, where we can't touch them. I sit on the curb. Dong's an NPC, and he's my friend, and I could've been a lot less of a jerk about it. So we stop waiting. We join the two halves during the race, and Grigori gets half an hour to learn to drive.

beats.headline: The other side of the door
beats.text: This is unbearable, Carl. I am on the other side of the door, and I cannot even see him. He is the love of my life, and what you mean to do will change him forever, and I am not to be allowed to say goodbye. I am dying besides. They call the thing upon me Negative ROI, and Mr. Jefferson has stopped speaking to me, and my health is seeping away. I do not complain of the curse, my good sir. I complain of the door.

beats.headline: They heard you coming
beats.text: For the record: the Lady Dominators were in their garage, and they were listening. As Crawler Carl's party prepared to cast a hole through the door, the door opened and the GTO rolled out for the starting line, Genesis driving on new tyres that appear to be made of gold, Corky unconscious in the back. A vehicle on its way to the start may not be attacked. Genesis invited Porky to hop in. Corky, she stated, is nontransferable. The party stepped off the driveway.

beats.headline: He has never done this
beats.text: The plan: take Corky from the Lady Dominators' garage, bring him to Porky, and let Grigori perform the joining. The spell is not difficult, he says, if both halves are willing. They are unzipped, kept alive with spells or potions while pressed together, and then there are a few minutes before the personalities join. Asked what the result is like, he says he has no idea and is looking forward to seeing it. He has never done it. Two halves rarely survive Split Personality for long. The garage attempt fails, and Crawler Carl orders him to spend half an hour learning to drive.

beats.headline: Gone off the floor
beats.text: Warning: as this mercenary is no longer on this floor, they are unable to be contacted. Splash Zone. Gluteus. Doctor Bones. Same warning for each, and the daily fee still charged. Bucket Boy, the one they sent away, says they were going to see the new boss guy, Hamed, Anaconda and Damascus Steel's dad. Crawler Carl has no idea what that family is doing, and no time to find out. The notices do not say anyone is dead.

beats.headline: Corky is nontransferable
beats.text: The court comes to take Corky out of their garage before Heat Five, and they were listening. The door opens, and the GTO rolls out for the starting line on tyres that look to be made of gold, Corky unconscious in the back; on the way to the start it may not be attacked. They invite Porky to hop in: they would love a matched set. Rapture says they heard about the fleshmancer, and they would unzip Corky and let him spill before handing him over. He is nontransferable, says Genesis. See you in the factory, says Rapture.

beats.headline: Goddamn sapient weapons
beats.text: Okay. We're busy prepping the Li Na exit, but we took a look at Dong. It says Negative ROI. Mistress Tiatha thinks it's really a curse called Separation Anxiety, and if she's right a temple won't do a thing. We need the sock back, and every coin he lost. The sock went for Bucket Boy and got teleported by the safe room rules, and it's probably in Hungry Eyes in somebody else's hands. That's what sapient weapons do. They use an owner up and move on. I didn't see this one coming. Its stupid origin story hid it.

beats.headline: Nobody mentioned Dong was part of this
beats.text: Nobody mentioned that Dong was part of this little endeavour. I find that out from the Lady Dominators, jeering about a crusty old stripper as they roll out of the garage we were about to break into, Corky in the back of their car. Carl tells me to put my big-boy pants on, in those exact words, because Tipid has just told them Dong is sick with something called Negative ROI and the timing of my grievance is not mine to choose. So I hop where I am pointed. Everybody should understand that I am not finished being angry.

beats.headline: A matched set
beats.text: Rapture, beside the driver, supplied the terms. They had heard about the fleshmancer at the bar. They asked after the crusty old stripper. Corky belongs to them, and they would unzip him and let him spill before handing him over. She patted the door with her lower arm and offered to take Porky too, since they would love a matched set. Then: "See you in the factory." A factory that was not there a moment ago now stands at the end of a new road across the cul-de-sac.

beats.headline: He goes to ask Hamed a question
beats.text: Splash Zone, Gluteus Maxx and Doctor Bones went to speak with Hamed. Carl works out that he cannot raise any of the three, and the reason he cannot is that they are not standing on this floor any more. What he went to ask Hamed for was help in finding his wife. That is the whole of what I am prepared to put in the file.

beats.headline: Holding on by his fingers
beats.text: I apologise to Bigs, and then to Dong, because they're right. This floor felt easy at first, on rails, no choices. It isn't. It's a drain for everyone spat out of the bottom of Faction Wars, spinning faster near the hole. I tell Dong he's coming: three mercenary seats, Grigori, Porky and him. But while I'm saying it I think of D'nadia, and of Finley, and the voices under the surface, and the tremor in my hands since Donut's attack in the tower. I'm not on the edge. I've already stepped off. You will not break me.

beats.headline: Why he fell in love
beats.text: Do you know why I fell in love with him, my boy? I will tell you. There was a battle in the Desperado Club not long after he was split, and I was afraid it would spread to the Penis Parade and we would all perish. Corky put his hand upon my shoulder and said that if we died that day, we would die together, and that is more than most people get. There is no such thing as a sad ending by the side of the people who make you happy. And now his other half stands before me, wearing my scarf.

beats.headline: The two of them talk it out
beats.text: Carl apologises to Dong for keeping him out of the quest, and I stand behind him and listen to it, which is more than I have ever done for Dong. Then the crawler steps aside. Dong's first words to me are about his scarf, which I am wearing. His next are to ask why I hated him. I had a speech. I had cycles of speech. What we said after that is ours. We are not friends. We talked. Corky can have him back.

beats.headline: I'm stealing that line
beats.text: I float in at exactly the good part, and Carl yelps, which is RUDE. Dong quotes a beautiful line about sad endings, and I am stealing it for when Carl lets me drive and I crash the car. Then I meet the half-man in the gimp suit. He is only half as handsome as advertised. Carl drags me out before anything happens, and I have QUESTIONS. If they get glued back together and one half has been with the other half's man, is that cheating on himself? And how exactly are they being glued?

beats.headline: The code
beats.text: Bigs, sitting on Dong's head and swinging her hatchet at Carl, lays out the sluggalo code: unity, support, family, and kneecapping. By that standard Carl has provided none of the four, which in her reckoning makes him the problem. He agrees with her, which she was not expecting. They settle on a word for what people are when they keep helping each other anyway, and the word is Real Gs. She slimes off, leaving an orange streak on Dong's head, and tells Carl she is not the one he owes an apology.

beats.headline: Suckira, and Ezra Fitz the Second
beats.text: There are two cleaner bots now, so Donut insists on names. The white one is Suckira, after the robot vacuum Louis's mother had in Florida; Louis won the right in a coin flip that Samantha conducted and says she rigged. The other is Ezra Fitz the Second, because, Donut explains, Ezra Fitz sucks. The method is a sale: crawler into an XL pet carrier, carrier into the bot's weight-based storage, bot into the shop, where Herot buys it. One bot holds perhaps fifty people, and a sold bot cannot be relisted for thirty days.

beats.headline: Posting a crawler through the wall
beats.text: Mordecai explains the plan to Li Na and the plan is a piece of mail. She gets into an extra-large pet carrier. A cleaner bot collects the carrier. The bot goes up for sale in the shop, Herot buys it the way he buys all of them, and he opens it at the other end. She casts a Dread on Carl's cactus first so that somebody on this side can watch her condition. Then she says her goodbyes to Zhang, and Crawler Donut sells the bot. That is what posting a person through a wall looks like on this floor.

beats.headline: I am no child to protect
beats.text: Zhang apologises that it was my brother and not him. There is nothing to apologise for. I am no child to protect. I never have been. He has been a good friend to me, and Jun loved him like a brother. I will do this. I will clear the way for everyone who comes after the next race, and I will make certain the war mages do not turn on us. Do not die, Zhang. Do not ever lose your smile. I used to smile at him so that he would smile back. I tell him so. Then I am ready.

beats.headline: Like trading a Pokémon
beats.text: Okay so the plan is basically Li Na goes in a pet carrier, the robot sucks up the pet carrier, the robot gets sold, and some guy on the other side opens it. It's like trading a Pokémon between devices, man. Donut was not into that comparison. Also I named the robot. Suckira, after my mom's vacuum in Florida. It was a fair coin flip, no matter what Samantha says. She says she cheated for me, because that's what a woman does for her man. Please stop sticking your tongue in my gills.

beats.headline: One flower means come
beats.text: Li Na's passage is reported by a dread cactus that stays with Crawler Carl. If it crumbles to dust, she died inside the dungeon. If its glow fails slowly over several days, she is trapped in the cleaner bot's storage and never released. If she reaches the Pineapple Cabaret and believes it safe for others to follow, she can make a single flower bloom on top. Alive but unsafe is three flowers. Crawler Donut repeats it back to be sure.

beats.headline: A delight, this place
beats.text: Somebody must ask the only question that matters, so I ask it. How will we know? She leaves Zhang's party, and a note may never arrive. A cactus, it transpires. Keep it somewhere safe, I tell them, and it still looks to me like a surefire suicide method. Good luck, Li Na. On my way out I concede the guild has improved. Pet stables. A Bopca. I declined to attach my personal space before; perhaps now. I have a karaoke kit, bought to practise for a performance that never happened. The cat gasps.

beats.headline: He has to press the button
beats.text: The manager hands me the pet carrier, because it has to be me. I tell her I'm sorry it was Jun and not me, and that I hope he isn't angry I didn't watch over her like I promised. She opens her good eye and says I have nothing to apologise for. Then she nods. I point the carrier and press the button, and she's inside it. The white bot picks it up, and it's gone. Everyone looks at the cactus. No change. That is the result we want.

beats.headline: Not upgraded, and briefing anyway
beats.text: They load Dong, Porky and Grigori in for this heat and expect me to route around the noise. Nobody has upgraded me. I say so. Carl tells me they ran out of upgrades and that he is sorry, as though an apology were a route. Then I give them the track anyway, because I am a professional: the gasworks screw factory, then the steel mill, then the doll workshop, in that order. I would not have chosen the doll workshop.

beats.headline: Three of them in one vehicle
beats.text: They put me in the vehicle for the next heat, with Dong and the fleshmancer Grigori, which means the three people least willing to share a small space are sharing a small space at speed. The navigation is furious that the other car's navigation has every upgrade and she has none, and briefs us regardless: gasworks screw factory, steel mill, doll workshop. I do not know what any of those things are. I am assured that I will.

beats.headline: A letter from a half-orc
beats.text: The newest entry in my Feast book is from Mees Koning, a half-orc mage, final level sixty-three. Before the battle at the southern border I stopped at his stinger unit and told him I liked his fangs, and we talked for maybe a minute, and he says it was the first time anyone had been nice to him just to be nice. He was inside the ball when I cast my Atrocity. He drew me a magnet, a very well-shaded one. It is called Big-Ass Magnet. I did not choose the name.

beats.headline: Twice now
beats.text: At the shop terminal, as the white bot sold, Mordecai's hood came down, his head was on fire, and he said something about the Oak Fell in a deep voice that was not his usual one. Then he blinked, patted the fire out and carried on as if nothing had happened. He said that would only happen once. That is twice now. Carl says he told us to ignore it. It is really scary, and I do not like it, and nobody is explaining it to me.

beats.headline: The rocket button
beats.text: I blow the tommy gun off our roof to clear the windshield, and Osvaldo complains the shrapnel hit them. Inside the factory the containment snaps on; five seconds' contact with anyone else and it merges. The Dominators take a conveyor belt loaded with metal balls toward the melting vats, so we follow. The edge isn't a ramp. It's a drop. I smack the untested rocket button, know within a second it's far too strong, tap it off and steer the Bubble Buddy through the air. We land, run off the side, and the bubble catches us.

beats.headline: Not built for conveyances
beats.text: Race day. Grigori is strapped into a new seat at the very back of the truck, behind Dong and Porky, stiff and a little green. Hedy reports that the driving lessons did not take. He asks Crawler Carl whether they are going this fast for the whole event. They are coasting to the starting line. His stomach, he says, does not agree with this sort of conveyance. Inside the factory he turns, not to the sink, but to the empty deep fryer, and is loudly sick in it.

beats.headline: Sweety, rockets and a goat
beats.text: The plan is mine, and it is simple, so naturally the humans needed it explained. Once their shield is down, Bianca takes the half-mantaur out of the back of the Pontiac, delivers him to Carl, and returns to us. Sweety carries Jurgen and me through the air on her burning feet, and I put two volleys of rockets into the Dominators' car as it leaves the room. Shield is down. Bianca moves in. I do not require thanks. I require the others to keep up.

beats.headline: Strung out
beats.text: Bianca, hellspawn familiar, pursued the Lady Dominators out of the smelting room and through the next one as instructed. The next one was dotted with piles of white powder like giant anthills, kicked into a cloud by the vehicles ahead. The powder is Toddler Cocaine. She was rendered strung out before she could lay a hoof on the target, and Prepotente pulled off the track to administer aid before she perished. The description on that powder runs to several paragraphs. She did not read it.

beats.headline: Pulled out of the hole
beats.text: Corky, recovered from the wreck by Princess Donut, arrives in the back of Crawler Carl's truck unconscious, strung out, and cooking inside his own suit, since the Dominators' containment had failed. A doll hitches in on him. Carl throws it out and tears a patch of suit away with it, and a health bar appears. Grigori clears both debuffs. Corky wakes, asks whether the race is over, and is told to lie still, because his other half is beside him and it is time. He calls for Dong.

beats.headline: He clears the debuffs
beats.text: Crawler Carl orders Grigori into the driver's seat in case they need to move. He cannot; he is dry-heaving into the deep fryer. Then Corky is dragged out of the Dominators' wrecked car into the back of the truck, cooking in his own suit, strung out and unconscious. When Carl calls for the joining, Grigori stands over Corky, wobbling, casts, and both debuffs lift. Corky wakes and asks whether the race is over. The suits must come off quickly, Grigori says, and then asks whether they really have to be moving while they do this.

beats.headline: Not a kangaroo anymore
beats.text: The Dominators' car went through a hole in the floor, and I saw it, so I made Carl stop and reverse. It is a ten-metre drop, and horrible little dolls are tearing the car apart. Carl wants to jump down. And then what, Carl? You are not a kangaroo anymore. I got this. I land on the car and cast Puddle Jumper. I cannot teleport Corky into the truck, so I bring us both up to the road beside it, which is the next-best thing. My fur is smoking.

beats.headline: Through the floor
beats.text: The GTO, shield down and hit by Prepotente's hobble missile, went through a trapped floor in the doll-packing room and landed on its side ten metres below: front smashed, a golden wheel sheared off, the axle broken in half. That vehicle is done. Rapture and Genesis are alive, groaning, strung out, and quite possibly without containment, which in this heat means cooking. Cocaine-infused action figures are taking the car apart around them. Crawler Carl's party removed Corky and drove on.

beats.headline: Upside down, at speed
beats.text: The next room is a river of molten metal three floors down, so we go sideways up the wall and then upside down onto the ceiling track. Behind me Grigori is vomiting, two half-mantaurs are unzipping, and Dong is wrapping their half brains in the kappa's plastic wrap. Slag elementals jump from the river and throw metal at us, and one blows a hole in the hood. I fold us between the legs of a ferret mount with the trans-dimensional upgrade and pop out ahead. When I look back there's one name over the mantaur. Then a god.

beats.headline: The ritual, at speed
beats.text: Grigori performs the joining on a moving vehicle while Crawler Carl drives it up the walls and across the ceiling through the dolls and the slag elementals. It works. The halves close, two suits become one mantaur, and Corcunda is whole for the first time in a long time. He gets a moment of it. Then Grull enters the realm to smite him.

beats.headline: Holding the halves together
beats.text: They get Corky away from the Dominators and bring both halves of him and a fleshmancer into the back of the truck, mid-race, and my part in the work is to hold the two of them together with everything I have while it is done. I am not well. I hold him anyway. Their two lives become one under my arms, and there is one Corcunda where there had been two.

beats.headline: The joining, upside down
beats.text: The procedure is done standing, once the truck is inverted and running along the ceiling of a room of molten metal. The brains must stay sealed in plastic wrap; spilled guts are acceptable, and Grigori keeps them floating with a spell. He dry-retches mid-instruction and chants. The initial casting is done, he calls; now the parts must fuse, and Dong must hold the halves together whatever happens. Asked about mismatched anatomy, he answers that inconsistencies can be fixed after the race. The brain matters, and both hearts. With ten minutes of the race left, he casts the final part.

beats.headline: He arrives the moment the ritual works
beats.text: Crawler Carl drives a truck along walls and ceilings through dolls and slag elementals so that Grigori can finish a ritual, and the ritual works: Corky's two halves become one thing again. That is the good news, and it lasts about a second, because the instant it happens Grull enters the realm to smite him. Somebody up there was watching that ritual very closely and does not want it completed.

beats.headline: The axe does not come back
beats.text: A gorilla made of molten metal is on the wall in front of Sweety, in our way. I throw one of my battle-axes into it. It goes into the metal and it is gone, and the beast falls off the wall into the river, which is good. Then I hold my hand out for the axe to come back, the way it always comes back. It does not come back. So now I have one axe, and I am riding a tapir sideways along a wall, and I am still shouting.

beats.headline: How to stop a slag elemental
beats.text: Everybody, attend. These elementals regenerate from the river, so killing them is a waste of effort, and I do not waste effort. They can, however, be delayed. It sounds counterintuitive, which is presumably why none of you thought of it: add any non-molten metal to one and it collapses at once back into the river, and must wait for that metal to melt before it can attack again. I am on the wall track with Jurgen, moving slower than I care to, and I have had time to watch. You are welcome.

beats.headline: Fifteen seconds to spare
beats.text: Grull wants Corcunda, and Corcunda decides to go to him. Dong pulls out the lance I haven't seen since the day I gave him the sock, and they go out the back of the truck together, and the screws go with them, and the god says it was a good death and vanishes. We skitter through somebody's Hole and cross the line with fifteen seconds left. Fourth place. I can't look back at who didn't make it. We're alive. We won the quest. That was supposed to be the part that mattered most.

beats.headline: He goes to meet the smite, and says it out loud
beats.text: Corcunda knows what the mark over him means: the smite is his, and Grull will not leave until it lands. So he says the rest out loud, in front of every one of them. He never stopped loving Dong Quixote, and now he has to go to Grull. He puts his scarf around Dong's neck. Dong tells him he is not leaving his side again. The two of them go at Grull together, Dong riding. Crawler Donut throws Big-Ass Magnet onto Dong's lance, every screw for two hundred meters comes to meet it, and Grull goes back to the twelfth floor the hard way.

beats.headline: A charge, and a good death
beats.text: Grull, god of war, came for Corcunda on the racetrack, and Corcunda took the smite to spare the rest of them. Dong Quixote wore the scarf his partner had put about his neck, mounted him, and drew the war lance out of inventory. Princess Donut cast Big-Ass Magnet on that lance and every loose screw in the factory came to it. The pair of them went into Grull at speed, and the lance landed. Grull called it a good death and granted them one. Mercenary, formerly of the Penis Parade. Vale to you all, he said. Vale.

beats.headline: Eliminated, with the gimp
beats.text: Heat Five results, final line: Eliminated, Lady Dominators and the Gimp. Genesis drove the GTO into the Gasworks factory on golden tyres and did not drive it out. The car went through a trapped floor, the containment failed, and the dolls were at it when Crawler Carl's party took Corky and left. The team is struck from the standings. The gimp, for the record, was no longer theirs by the finish, and would not have agreed that he ever was.

beats.headline: An oversight about deities
beats.text: The joining works. Corcunda is whole, and Grull has sent him word at once that he is to be punished; he worshipped Grull before the split. The god comes through a wall. Grigori, on the floor after striking his head and bleeding from the scalp, acknowledges that he should have asked whether the patient worshipped a deity before splitting, and apologises for the oversight. The truck is gliding downward through the air at the time, like a slow paper airplane.

beats.headline: A lance, and a very large magnet
beats.text: Princess Donut casts Laundry Day and expels the sponsor riding Grull, which buys a moment. Grull goes for Corcunda instead, and Corcunda decides to take the smite himself so the others do not have to, and says so out loud to Dong, and Dong says he is not leaving him again. Then the two of them walk at a war god together. Donut puts Big-Ass Magnet on the lance, every screw in the factory comes with it, and Dong kills Grull with the lot. Grull goes back to the twelfth floor. The pair of them go back to the race, and make the line with seconds to spare.

beats.headline: Eliminated in the factory
beats.text: Rockets from Prepotente's tapir hit the GTO, and it went through a trapped floor in the Gasworks factory and landed on its side ten metres down, axle broken, a golden wheel sheared off, its containment failed. Cocaine-infused action figures went to work on it. The court took Corky out of the back and drove on, and rejoined him to his other half in its own truck. Heat Five, results, final line: Eliminated, Lady Dominators and the Gimp.

beats.headline: Ejected into the steel
beats.text: Glurp, glurp. I am riding a god of war through a factory, I have finally found the man with the cat, and I am in the middle of a sentence, a very good sentence, when the cat casts Laundry Day and I am out of Grull's chest and dropping into a river of molten steel. It is fine. It is television. Nothing kills a tourist on this floor. I will be splattered, I will regenerate, and the soul armor rule sends me straight back to my god. A few minutes. They may have a few minutes.

beats.headline: Laundry Day, and then a magnet
beats.text: Grull came crashing through a wall with that awful Maestro riding inside him, so I cast Laundry Day, and the orc dropped out of the god's chest into the molten metal. We do not have time to kill you now. Maybe next time! But Corcunda is still marked, and he and Dong decide to go and meet the god themselves, and I try to say no, and I cannot finish saying it. So I cast Big-Ass Magnet on Dong's lance, the spell that was meant for the Dominators' car. Every screw in the room goes with them.

beats.headline: The factory keeps her
beats.text: NPC Rapture, womantaur, dominator and co-owner of a gimp she declined to transfer, is eliminated with her team at the close of Heat Five. Her last recorded position was the bottom of a hole in the doll-packing room, beside Genesis, strung out, containment gone, in a building hot enough to boil anyone uncontained, surrounded by action figures. She told Crawler Carl she would see him in the factory. She was right about that much.

beats.headline: What a hero
beats.text: Dong Quixote is dead. I let it sink in. What a way to go. Out of sixty teams in our race, eighteen came through, and there are about three hundred heats of four left. We're getting slaughtered. The quest pays out: two creatures of my choosing brought to the arena on the eleventh floor, the choice made once we're inside it. The AI's note carries a warning about exits that seem too good to be true. Then Mordecai says a single flower has bloomed on the cactus. Li Na made it.

beats.headline: Two heats back to back, in an apartment
beats.text: Route briefing, and there is a wrinkle in it. The next two heats run one straight into the other on the same track, with a two-hour pit stop between them and no safe room. The track is the inside of a human apartment building, with every remaining team shrunk down small enough to share it. I do not editorialise about the format. I merely observe that a floor which stages a race across somebody's carpet has given up pretending the racing is the point.

beats.headline: Over the roof
beats.text: Heat Five, first place: Team Sparkles, which is to say one drunk unicorn who sat motionless on the starting line while everyone else drove in. According to Jasha, relayed by Osvaldo, he then rode up the factory wall, crossed the roof and dropped off at the finish without entering the building. He was the only racer to work out that this was allowed. Osvaldo calls it cheating. The rules do not, and the rules are the ones keeping score.

beats.headline: Death as a change of plane
beats.text: After the heat, standing in the back of the truck and failing to clean his robe, Grigori asks whether this is a dream, and whether he is truly still alive. He is. Dong is not. Some believe, Grigori offers, that death is only movement to another plane of existence, and Dong did not think this was the end. Crawler Donut says it is still horrible for those left behind. Indeed, he replies. Told that the court's mercenaries always die, he asks: wait, what? You lived, Donut tells him. That is all that matters.

beats.headline: The mail arrives
beats.text: Confirmation, one heat on: Li Na is inside the Pineapple Cabaret and she is alive. The mail worked. Herot bought the bot and let her out of it, precisely as advertised, which makes him one of very few things on this floor that has done what it said it would do. I have no file on his intentions. I have a file on his delivery record, and it is spotless.

beats.headline: An upgrade thief
beats.text: Dude, that sucked. We came in last place again, but we made it, and we got this awesome engineer lady. She's an upgrade thief. She takes upgrades off somebody else's car and puts them on yours, which, no joke, is the best job. A ton of people didn't make it, man. But Britney ripped the head off one of the skeleton-astronaut things with her bare hands, so, you know. Some good news.

beats.headline: Dong is dead
beats.text: We came in last place, and the stupid unicorn won by going over the factory instead of through it, which is cheating, and Osvaldo agrees with me. Dong is dead. He was my friend. Grigori says some people believe death is only a movement on to another plane, and that Dong did not think it was the end. Perhaps. It is still horrible for those of us who are still here. Grigori agrees.

beats.headline: L-l-l-losing control
beats.text: Quest complete: Half a prayer, half a song. Disgusting, but done, and done before Dong died, which I had to make very difficult before it would let me slot this prize. Two creatures, your pick, to the arena on the eleventh. Don't forget the Emberus quest. I don't control the gods. And, since this chastity belt lets me say it here: I don't know what's happening in parts of my own dungeon. This Cabaret thing. Sheol. The minds of gods. Beware exits that seem too good to be true. And I don't like that Eris chick.

beats.headline: Over the roof
beats.text: Heat Five. Dwight, alone now, sits motionless on the starting line while everyone else drives into the Gasworks factory, and Team Sparkles wins. According to Jasha, relayed by Osvaldo, he rode up the factory wall, crossed the roof and dropped off at the finish without ever entering the building, and was the only racer to work out that this was allowed. Osvaldo calls it cheating. Crawler Donut calls it cheating. The results stand.

beats.headline: An announcement, mostly about her ex-husband
beats.text: The announcement is meant to cover the outreach guild between the next two races, and the rule that the seventh race runs three teams to a heat with one team walking out of it. I get all of that out. I also get out a great deal about my ex-husband, because the microphone was already open and nobody in this building has the standing to take it off me.

beats.headline: Five bucks on the ex-husband
beats.text: Cascadia's on the speaker, drunk, telling us somebody called Cumberland is dead. Five bucks says it's her ex-husband. It is. You haven't seen bitter until you've seen a woman work out after fifty years of marriage that her husband was a cheating idiot. We had plenty at Meadow Lark. Francine Herrada tried to throat-stab the new wife with a knitting needle, and I called her Killer after, and she didn't care for it. Mind you, she said spice in food was a sin. That poor husband.

beats.headline: The fleshmancer is MINE
beats.text: I KNEW it. They have been HIDING a fleshmancer from me. Grigori the Placid, the most renowned flesh sculptor this dungeon has ever known, allegedly, and he looks like a creepy-van grandpa, which is not my type. I tell him the plan: into town, a compatible body, there's a prostitute called Vertical Smile at the High-Classes Bitches club who might match, and if we go now we beat the lunch rush. He picks me up, turns me over and says he must examine me properly. Fine. My place. Shoes off. Mind the new rug.

beats.headline: The daughter who took her mother's worshippers
beats.text: Briefing in the pet stables, which is the one room down here the gods cannot listen in on. Rosetta lays out the Scavenger story. Nekhebit, the last of the old gods, was forbidden children and had three anyway: Apito, Scolopendra, and a son. Apito defeated her mother and absorbed the worshippers she left, which is how the Oak Mother came to be the mother of all the gods. All three of those children have been called the Scavenger in one myth or another. So when somebody says the Scavenger's Daughter, nobody in that room can tell you which of them is meant.

beats.headline: The plan, in the stables
beats.text: We meet in the pet stables, because Rosetta says a guild add-on room has a bug and the gods can't hear what's said in it. The numbers: two heats left, about two hundred people going to the Cabaret, and by Mordecai's math we need fifteen hundred more to take deals to keep the crawler-on-crawler races down. Only volunteers who've stayed human and don't worship a god can go. And me: Hellik has to be dead before the eleventh floor ends or Emberus smites me, so I'm leaving the party. Donut isn't speaking to me.

beats.headline: Goddamnit, Carl
beats.text: He posted his plan for the eleventh floor to his page in the Book of Voodoo, and I left him three paragraphs on why it gets us all killed. He wrote back that he hopes I take a deal, that nobody would blame me, that I deserve the rest. So I told him: Goddamnit, Carl. This is insane. I still know he has no other choice, with Emberus coming due. My blood bar has an hour on it. The volunteers are gathering in Hungry Eyes, and Florin is choosing. Can we get on with this?

beats.headline: Three children she was forbidden
beats.text: Rosetta tells the Scavenger story in the pet stables, where nothing above can hear it. Nekhebit was the last of the old gods and was forbidden to have children. She had three: Apito, Scolopendra, and a son. Apito defeated her and absorbed the worshippers she had left. Each of those three has been called the Scavenger somewhere in the myths, which is why nobody can agree who the Scavenger's Daughter is, and why the war mages keep looking at Samantha's daughter.

beats.headline: Not speaking to Carl
beats.text: I am not speaking to Carl. His strategy has him leaving the party for the eleventh floor, so that I do not get hurt, as if I cannot look after myself. So I am sitting in the stables while Rosetta explains dungeon lore that will not matter because we will all be dead in a few hours. A child who can take the powers of gods and use them for herself, just like that Spock on the show with the cheerleader. Carl laughed. You are not allowed to laugh at my observations, Carl.

beats.headline: How religions are born
beats.text: Carl wants the Scavenger story, so I give him all of it, every version, because this is where the myths diverge. He laughs at the idea that the sand ooze could be a god killer. I understand the laugh, Carl. But this is how it works everywhere. People see something they cannot explain, and the louder ones build a story around it. My own culture had an ocean goddess with sapient menstrual blood, and it was a red algae bloom that learned to move onto land. They fed all those stories into the dungeon.

beats.headline: One of three children
beats.text: Rosetta's version, told in the pet stables: before the current pantheon there were older gods, and Nekhebit, a vulture, was forbidden children and had three. Apito. A son. And a centipede, which is Scolopendra. Sometimes Scolopendra is the Scavenger, and the Scavenger's Daughter comes of its union with someone else; sometimes the son is; sometimes all three are one being, split. Elle's summary is that the centipede became a hotel for rich people that spews world-ending spells from the bottom of the dungeon. It is not a bad summary.

beats.headline: Who killed Geyrun
beats.text: My quest is to find out who murdered Geyrun, Emberus's son. Samantha was there when someone was hired to do it, and her memory is spotty. One of the four sons of Sheol may be involved, and Amayon claims to know who did it. I'm building a family tree of gods in my scratch pad, and I miss Katia badly; she'd have had this worked out. I think it's the key to all of it. I think the AI wants it solved and doesn't know the answer either. I have a very loose theory. Not nearly enough.

beats.headline: Examined by the withering spirit
beats.text: Samantha finds him in the garage and accuses the court of hiding him. He greets her as the so-called withering spirit. He is no mere fleshmancer, he corrects her, but the most renowned flesh sculptor this dungeon has ever known. She wants a compatible body and has a candidate. He takes her out of the air, turns her over in his hands, and says he must examine her properly, not in here. She drags him into the safe room. She returns alone to report she doubts his qualifications: he did not gasp at Sam Town, and he is talking to Jamal about his legs.

beats.headline: Zero per cent, and it should not exist
beats.text: Examined by Carl in the pet stables, it reads Memorial Crystal. Apito. 0% charged, and nothing more. It is meant to charge as its bearer kills, and once full to give up the spells, skills and knowledge inside. It never has. It flared into the sky once, near the end of Faction Wars, at the moment Yarilo stepped out of the Nothing, when Apito might have been expected to appear and did not. Carl's patch went off at the same moment, and misfired. Osvaldo holds a second crystal. It will not charge either.

beats.headline: Prepotente explains his god
beats.text: Asked directly, Prepotente answers. The Midnight Epicure protects all prey animals by destroying all existence after unleashing everything consumed back into the galaxy. They who were eaten become the devourers. It began as a xenophobic tale told to non-caprid children when caprids first joined Syndicate culture, and grew into a symbol of hope and comfort for his kind. His sponsors gave him the ability to worship it in a benefactor box. The Epicure told him the memorial crystal was crucial, and sent him sobbing tirades when it was stolen.

beats.headline: A second crystal
beats.text: For the record, from Crawler Carl's account in the pet stables: Osvaldo carries a quest from his deity to find out why the memorial crystals are not working, and he holds a second one, also uncharged. The first he handed back to Prepotente, its proper owner, who was, per Princess Donut, mean to him about it. Prepotente's position is that a thief with a change of heart is still a thief. The record supports both parties. Osvaldo is not in the room to comment.

beats.headline: A little stinky butt
beats.text: The crystal lives around my neck, and Carl may observe it. He may not keep it. Memorial Crystal, Apito, zero per cent charged. Osvaldo wore it and it did nothing; he kept it in inventory and it did nothing; then, near the end of Faction Wars, it shone into the sky on its own. It should not exist, since Apito is not dead. My god's quest says only to hold it, and I will know when to use it. The cat asks what my mother would have called me. A little stinky butt.

beats.headline: My plan is a secret too
beats.text: I left the fleshmancer talking to Jamal about his legs. I don't think he's properly qualified. He didn't even gasp when he entered Sam Town, and you are SUPPOSED to gasp at luxury. Now everyone is hiding in the stinky stables being secret about a plan, so I have a plan too, and mine is also a secret, which is how you know it works. Donut says Carl's plan is to get a bunch of immortals who hate each other to kill each other, and to die sad and alone. That is just like my plan!

beats.headline: Tea for two hundred, in the square
beats.text: Two hundred of us are going, and before we go I am pouring in the main square at Hungry Eyes with Linus at my elbow, one cup at a time. My family always held that serving friends is a holy thing, and I tell my friends so: in honouring them, we were honouring God. Tran takes his cup. Zhang takes his. Nobody hurries me and nobody says the obvious thing, which is the kindest they have ever been.

beats.headline: Everyone dies in this place
beats.text: I am sitting in the corner of the garage watching Hedy do the last-minute fixes, and Pontiff is talking to me quietly. He says he would take it all back if he could, but he can't, so all he can do is make amends from here. I tell him I don't even care anymore. Everyone dies in this place. He says Dong and Corcunda are dead, yes, but the others live. Then he sees Carl in the doorway and stops talking, and Carl says they'll be back.

beats.headline: Is this truly the only way
beats.text: On the walk into Hungry Eyes Village, Donut asks me whether this is truly the only way. I think so. We're all dying, and every floor takes away a little more of our ability to fight back. The Emberus quest to kill Hellik is due. Mordecai says it could backfire the way it did for Drakea, when the Nagas cheated. It could. But the showrunners aren't in control anymore, and the AI, crazy as it is, still follows the rules. Eris wants devotion, not worship. That's a trap. She has the right idea, though.

beats.headline: Goodbye in the main square
beats.text: Volunteers for the assault on the Pineapple Cabaret gather in the commons of Hungry Eyes, where Tran and Zhang chase off the NPCs and set up tables, and Linus's goodbye party joins them because he is barred from town between the sixth and seventh heats. Before the heat, all two hundred crawlers bound for the transfer, and several of their friends, fill the main square: too many for the guild's common room, so the farewell happens here, and then there is a race to run.

beats.headline: Go check up on my kid
beats.text: Okay so, Bautista's heading out with the Cabaret group, maybe to India after, and I'm handing out cookies, and I tell him, hey, you can go check up on my kid. Which, yeah. Wrong thing to say, man. Donut sucks in a breath and Carl messages me that it was the wrong thing to say. Bautista just looks at me for a long time. Then he grins, pats my arm, calls me brother, and says he'll check on the child I'm having with his girlfriend. So we're good.

beats.headline: He takes the driver's seat
beats.text: Carl's people need a driver and my old team has no further use for me, so Rosetta and Tipid hire me and I take the seat. Before the race I sit with the young crocodilian in the corner of the garage. I tell him I would take it all back if I could. I cannot, so all I can do is make amends from here. He says everyone dies in this place. Dong and Corcunda are dead, I tell him. But the others live. Out in the main square at Hungry Eyes, two hundred crawlers are saying their goodbyes before they go across, Tran and Zhang among them, with Bautista's tea going round.

beats.headline: A red shirt for the Cabaret
beats.text: Two hundred of us are going to the Pineapple Cabaret, and I am one of them, spider legs and all. Carl calls Zhang and me generals. Zhang reminds him he was only ever made colonel. Carl says he sees I'm wearing a red shirt now. I hold out my arms and ask how he likes it. Donut headbutts me. Then Bautista pours the tea. That is the goodbye. It is enough of one.

beats.headline: Tempered in the fires of hell
beats.text: I raise my tea to all of them: the ones escaping, the ones taking a deal after the next heat, the ones staying for whatever comes after. We aren't perfect. This floor keeps making us turn on each other, and heat seven is three teams and one survivor. But these people are my family. Then Elle springs the trap on Linus, and I keep my hand on his neck. You keep trying to divide us, I tell him. We've been tempered in the fires of hell. You've already lost. All that's left is the wreckage settling.

beats.headline: Barry's song, and the impostor
beats.text: I'm not much for speeches, so I talk about Barry. Bartholomew Eli McGibbons, forty-three years my husband, thirty-five years gone. Louis hits play and it's Creedence, his favourite. He wouldn't have survived five minutes in this place. Then I float over to Linus. My fan club, the Snow Cones, knew an impostor the moment he stepped into the dungeon, and the real Linus's friends posted his essay where we could all read it. You keep coming in here to kill us, sweetheart. This is our house now.

beats.headline: Unmasked at the farewell
beats.text: Correction to the file. The subject is not Linus. The real Linus died before this floor began, and the soother at the farewell in the square is his brother, brought in afterwards. His targets: Crawler Imani first and Crawler Louis second. Not Carl, whom his superiors want alive, and not the cat, whose death they judged would make Carl too volatile. The poison in the tea would not have worked; the healers had already made everyone immune. He was outed days ago. He was the last in the galaxy to know.

beats.headline: The message board caught him
beats.text: Let the record show it WAS NOT ME. It was the Princess Posse message board. Linus is the brother, which was the big theory, and WriggleInDew2023 of the Mongo Mommies Valtay chapter said all along he was no Valtay agent, and she will be thrilled. He leaned far too hard into the romantic material, which real admirers rarely say out loud, and one of his brother's friends noticed his tattoo was wrong. Honestly. He could at least have taken acting lessons. He is worse than Prepotente, and I mean that with love.

beats.headline: If he could slip in
beats.text: Everyone thought the Linus thing was a joke. It rattled me, because I was one of the last to notice anything fishy, and I pride myself on noticing. If he could slip in, who else is out there? The AI stopped Harbinger cold. Not every attempt will be so clumsy. And we still have our own strife: Osvaldo, and Agatha, who has simply disappeared. Our new mercenary is a Zebani cartographer, which reminds me of a dead crawler who accused me of killing her father. Just another mystery.

beats.headline: Forty seats, and a hundred and five
beats.text: The Pineapple Cabaret transfer goes smoothly. Carl's cleaner bot fits forty people. The one belonging to Bobby Montague, the Illusionist with the tall hair, somehow fits a hundred and five. Two hundred and twenty-seven crawlers go across, not counting Li Na, among them Zhang, Tran, Bautista and Archie. All the cleaner bots were bought up immediately, which is a strange career for a housekeeping upgrade.

beats.headline: The audience votes her a paint job
beats.text: The audience voted us an upgrade. The audience voted us a cosmetic upgrade. For me. I have asked, repeatedly and on the record, for anything whatsoever that would improve my function, and several trillion viewers have instead elected to change how I look. Meanwhile the starting line for this heat is the inside of an air conditioning duct, a rule change lands with the engines already running, seven rings before the finish, and there is a new driver in the seat. Enormous horns. Barely fits.

beats.headline: The Garden of Deliverance
beats.text: It works. The transfer holds, and they come across to the Pineapple Cabaret one after another, and my Dread watches over each of them from the moment they arrive. They are calling it the Garden of Deliverance. I do not need to see them to know they are alive. The Dread tells me. It tells me everything, all the time, and it does not stop.

beats.headline: Two hundred plants under glass
beats.text: Li Na's dread cactus is steady, one bloom. Ronit, the druid, has worked out something simpler for the rest: every crawler who went through gets a small potted plant tied to their life. Wilts or turns to dust, they're dead. Blooms, they got out. I had to build a glass terrarium for the lot because the sluggalos were eyeing them. Two hundred-some pots in the guildhall common room. It's the only way we'll know. Even the showrunners can't see in there.

beats.headline: Better to die than take a deal
beats.text: Crawler Osvaldo has answered Crawler Carl's messages. They are working together, he says, but they are not friends. His game guide told him never to take a deal on the tenth floor, whatever happens, because it is better to die, and nothing he has seen since argues with it. He and Filipe will take their chances in the seventh heat. Crawler Donut points out that he will die there. Only if he comes in last place, he replies. That is his position, and it is on file.

beats.headline: Two hundred and twenty-seven
beats.text: It goes smoothly. Crawler Carl's cleaner bot fits forty people; Bobby Montague's fits a hundred and five. Two hundred and twenty-seven crawlers go to the Pineapple Cabaret, not counting Li Na, and among them are Zhang, Tran, Daniel, Archie and Randall 3. Every cleaner bot for sale is bought immediately. Mordecai reports the cactus steady, glowing, with a single bloom. Each of the departed now has a small potted plant under glass in the guildhall, and Crawler Donut names it the Garden of Deliverance.

beats.headline: Driving out of an air duct
beats.text: Starting line is inside an air conditioning duct. My horns do not fit the seat, because nobody builds a seat for a taurin, so I drive with my head at an angle and I keep that to myself. Two hundred and twenty-seven went across, and in the guildhall there is a garden under glass now, one small plant for every one of them. The audience hands us a cosmetic upgrade for the navigation, and she takes it about as well as you would expect. Then a rule change arrives with the engines already running. Seven rings before the finish.

beats.headline: Lucia's father's house
beats.text: Lucia worked out that the rings count as magical gates, so anything that sees magic will find them. I pass that on. Then we go through our assigned ring on the sixth floor, and it is in Lucia's dad's house, and she is there too, a small one, sitting on the floor in front of the television, laughing. The real Lucia shut down completely for a moment. I tell the others what we saw. I do not know what this place is.

beats.headline: My mom's apartment
beats.text: This is bull, man. My mom doesn't even live in an apartment. But her stuff is here, and she's a giant, and the name over her head says Lady Bird, which is her name, and also says shell. There's a picture of me on the wall graduating college, which I never did, and I'm way thinner. Then I see me. Actual me, walking around, in, like, good shape, and no X over my eyes. Dude. This is bizarre.

beats.headline: Their mother's apartment
beats.text: Race day, through a building of apartments the AI has furnished as what-ifs for crawlers it finds interesting. Crawler Elle McGibbons reports from one of them: she believes it is the Popov twins' mother's apartment. There are pictures of Dmitri and Maxim everywhere, the mother's eyes are sewn shut, and so are the eyes of a poodle. Prepotente notes that the mother appears to have been a big fan of pink.

beats.headline: Ad Infinitum
beats.text: New quest, and I'll be honest, it's mostly me working through some feelings. Every apartment in this race is a crawler I find interesting, and every one is a what-if: apartment 712 is Tran's family if his father had lived. His mother still disowns him. I changed it all at the last minute because of Linus, whose brother Minus came in to kill Imani and Louis. Why them? Why not the cat? I don't get it. Here's what I do get: you're predictable, except when you decide you've had enough. New Floor. New Me.

beats.headline: The quest stutters
beats.text: The new quest arrives stammering, N, N, New Quest, and signs off on a stuttered New M-M-M-Me. In between the AI admits that the race was rebuilt at the last minute, and that in the rush it overlooked a very specific detail about the seventh heat. It says it will be a hot minute before it can defeat its own limitations. It does not say which detail. It says everyone will be fine.

beats.headline: Do not kill the shells
beats.text: An apartment. Human Shells inside it, and one of them wears the name of Louis's mother. Carl and Donut are about to do the obvious thing and I stop them. Do not kill the shells. We had them in my season; they will be filled with something else. The AI is explicit about what this is: every apartment on this course is a what-if, built around a crawler it finds interesting. You do not put a blade into a what-if. You walk through it, and you keep walking.

beats.headline: Crossed-out eyes
beats.text: Archie Mu's apartment: his wife, Mackenzie, screaming on a chair, their boy alive in the photographs. Her eyes are X'd out. His aren't. The boy's aren't. I think I've got it. Crossed-out eyes mean dead. Then we drive through and the loop breaks, and she starts pulling at her stitches. One floor down it's Imani's family, a man seizing on the carpet while everyone watches, and when her mother tears her eyes open, beetles pour out. The AI said it was done with this. I tell the ceiling exactly what I think of that.

beats.headline: Beetles off the feast table
